blocks.text: Jin organic compounds mein -CN functional group ho unhein alkanenitriles kehte hain. Maslan:
Alkanenitriles banane ka tareeqa chapter 21 mein diya ja chuka hai (halogenoalkane + KCN).

Alkanenitriles bohat se chemical reactions mein ahem hain, lekin in ka sab se ahem istemal hydrolysis (paani se torna) ke zariye carboxylic acids banana hai. Nitriles ki hydrolysis halke (dilute) acid aur halki alkali, dono se ho sakti hai.
Jab nitrile ko dilute acid, jaise dilute hydrochloric acid ya dilute sulphuric acid, ke saath garam kiya jata hai to carboxylic acid banta hai.

Jab nitrile ko dilute sodium hydroxide solution ke saath garam kiya jata hai to carboxylic acid ka salt aur ammonia bante hain. Is salt mein dilute hydrochloric acid dalne (acidification) se azad carboxylic acid mil jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Propanenitrile ko dilute sodium hydroxide ke saath garam karne par kaun si gas nikalti hai, aur organic product kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Ammonia (NH₃) gas; organic product sodium propanoate, CH₃CH₂COONa, jo HCl dalne par propanoic acid deta hai.

items: Nitriles R–CN; RX + KCN se bante hain (chapter 21).
Acid hydrolysis: RCOOH + NH₄Cl; alkaline hydrolysis: RCOONa + NH₃, phir HCl se RCOOH.
